assets.name: 01-cover
assets.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Create ONE finished Instagram carousel slide, portrait 3:4 ratio, target 1080 x 1440. AI CONCEPT LAB series POC 007. Premium charcoal indigo #121529 background, oversized bold white grotesk type, soft periwinkle #B8B5FF accents, warm apricot #F2C38B highlights. Thin header/footer rules, spaced uppercase AI CONCEPT LAB at top left, POC 007 top right. Footer AI CLAIM ASSISTANT bottom left, slide number bottom right. Keep all text within 80px horizontal and 90px vertical safe margins. Clean editorial startup design, readable, generous whitespace. No collage, no external canvas, no logos, no web URLs. Slide 01 / 05. Main headline exactly "A damaged laptop. A clearer claim." Subhead "AI INSURANCE CLAIM ASSISTANT". Large hero editorial photograph lower two-thirds: unbranded silver laptop on a dark desk, screen visibly cracked with branching fractures and a small bent lower-right casing corner, softly lit in indigo and warm amber. Photographic detail, believable ordinary laptop, no hands or people. Overlay a sleek small floating draft card near lower center: "PHOTO → QUESTIONS → CLAIM DRAFT". Supporting statement "Prepared for human review." Small "CONCEPT PREVIEW" label. Above footer "Swipe to see the build →". Photo is the star, headline on dark legible negative space.

assets.name: damaged-laptop
assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. One high-quality wide 3:2 editorial photograph for a fictional insurance-claim demo. Unbranded silver laptop open on a clean charcoal desk, visibly damaged screen with distinct branching glass fractures, dark partly illuminated display, modest visible dent and bent lower-right chassis corner. Clear full laptop unobstructed, accurate believable geometry, natural soft window light with subtle lavender shadows and warm highlights. No people, hands, personal papers, identifying text, brand logos or watermark. Damage visible but not exaggerated explosion. A synthetic example photo for software testing; no text or UI overlays.
